review_method: Root逐音视读完整适用公开乐谱，逐项对照现有来源及编配时值。 所有正式ScoreCodec事件均与已审时间线比较；隔离导入和重启校验通过，软件虚拟播放未发送真实输入。人工听感未验证，真实游戏未测试。
review_note: complete-existing-source-arrangement-with-explicit-intro-outro-and-grace-note-decisions All 45 printed bars of 312974 manually inspected and recorded, including underfilled m32 and trailing whole rests. Candidate uses full existing source arrangement, with instrumental intro/outro repetitions and the verse/chorus scope explicitly mapped, not silent truncation. 312974 G-major reference is transposed +1 semitone into existing source Ab register. Community key metadata is label-only; no second transpose is applied to already-absolute source pitches. Initial original B3 eighth is replaced by the published initial eighth-rest in 331314. Three descending intro motifs are retained as printed in 331314, using equivalent explicit 312974 note rhythms. Source skips most instrumental m4-5 fill; those unused reference notes are not appended. Main m6-28 beat2.5 are selected. Only true same-pitch ties merge. m11 outgoing tie is selected from 331314; 312974 has no tie there. m19 outgoing tie and m12-13 tie are explicit. Different-pitch slurs never merge. Chorus grace/fill attacks not present as full notes in selected 312974 edition are explicitly omitted. Every original attack and silence receives a disposition; true musical rests are reconstructed rather than retaining short MIDI/key-release gaps. Existing instrumental outro starts after reference m28 beat2.5 and repeats the intro 3-flat3-2 motif three times. It intentionally selects that reprise instead of the vocal flat3-flat3-2 ending at m28. Final source E4/Eb4 become the published intro/outro low5 Eb4 and low3 C4. Last three-beat source slot is C4 two beats plus one beat rest. Original 66-BPM variants use printed 312974 tempo; tempo derivative keeps 60 BPM supported by printed 331314. Source structure, both intro and outro, and every original event are fully accounted. Reference m32 is underfilled in 312974 and unused; the candidate invents no missing beat. Full vocal DS1/DS2 repetitions and reference trailing silent bars are not in existing source and are not appended.
